propositions: The 'change predates the gate' shell guard appears 24 times across six workflow files with inconsistent application and two known drift bugs (anxious-resistant-urson and sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly)
Test test.yml invokes check_readme_quickstart.py and probe_rebar.py without guards while gerrit-verify.yaml guards the same scripts, indicating uneven guard coverage

The guard cannot be moved to a shared repo file (composite action, shell helper, Python module) because such files are absent on pre-gate trees, breaking the empty-tree invariant pinned by test_ci_workflow_parity.py

Four gate steps carry behaviour that a bare skip would silently drop: _mutation.yml writes matrix output on skip, _optionality.yml guards two generators independently, _build-and-test.yml uses inverted form with no exit 0, and _build-and-test.yml guards a data file via variable substitution

The completeness test must assert every gate step either carries an -f guard for its file with canonical message or includes a # predates-gate-ok: marker with non-empty reason; the empty-tree test must verify guarded steps exit 0 with the message when run in an empty directory

Discovered gaps in _optionality.yml degradation-path (ticket marauding-hornblende-bluet) and test.yml golden-path (ticket cushy-soldierly-sunbear) are filed and linked discovered_from this ticket rather than fixed inline, as adding a guard changes which gates run on old bases
